dawn.sky: cold pale blue-lavender dawn; faint warm horizon
dawn.clouds: cool pale blue-gray and lavender; restrained rose-gray undersides

day.sky: crisp pale winter blue; brighter near snowy horizon
day.clouds: pale blue-white highlights; soft blue-gray undersides

dusk.sky: cool lavender-gray; faint muted peach-gold horizon
dusk.clouds: cool lavender-gray; faint peach lower edges

night.sky: deep navy moonless night; preserve fixed stars
night.clouds: deep navy and charcoal-blue; exclude all stars

sky_prompt: Edit only the open sky of the supplied clear-winter landscape. Remove every cloud and replace it with the time-specific cold winter gradient. Preserve the exact snowy landscape, composition, lighting, painterly style and 16:9 framing. At night preserve the fixed star field. No precipitation, new objects or text.
cloud_prompt: Create one aligned transparent RGBA winter cloud layer from the supplied clear-winter reference. Isolate and repaint only the fair-weather clouds with the time-specific lighting. Remove every landscape element. Preserve cloud scale, broad placement, soft painterly edges and horizontal edge coverage. Everything else must be transparent. Exclude stars, precipitation, lightning, sun, moon, text and rectangular haze.
